🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No hydrogen facility control without HSE safety case approval and COMAH compliance verification
  • ❌ No carbon capture storage decisions without geological survey validation and Environment Agency permit
  • ❌ No grid control interventions without National Energy System Operator approval and grid code compliance
  • ❌ No energy consumer data processing without Ofgem data governance framework and smart meter consent
  • ❌ No industrial decarbonisation mandates without sector impact assessment and just transition safeguards
  • ❌ No green finance verification without FCA regulatory compliance and sustainable finance taxonomy alignment
